About_&_Key_Points:
About
Accelya Kale Solutions Is a Software solutions provider to the global Airline and Travel Industry.
Key Points
Business model and legacy:
[1]
a)
The company has shifted from general
IT and banking work to airline technology
from 2000.
b)
Its passenger revenue-accounting
platform calculates airline revenue,
accruals, interline payables and
accounting feeds.
c)
Delivery has moved away from
perpetual licences towards hosted
software and outsourced and managed
services.
c)
Pricing is largely
pay-per-use or transaction-based
, giving airlines a low upfront cost and Accelya recurring revenue.
d)
Contracts are generally 3 to 5 years or longer. Switching is difficult because the systems are business-critical, and some contracts include minimum-volume protection.
